spans.s:
वैण वैण, अस्, m. (fr. वेणु), a cutter of
bamboos, a maker of bamboo-work; N. of a Ṛṣi.

वैणव, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to a bamboo,
produced from or made of bamboo; (अस्), m. a
student's staff cut from a bamboo, any bamboo staff;
a worker in bamboo or wicker-work; N. of a sacred
place of pilgrimage; (ई), f. bamboo manna; (अम्),
n. the fruit or seed of the bamboo.
वैणविक, अस्, m. a flutist, piper, flute-player.
वैणविन्, ई, m. epithet of Śiva.
वैणहोत्र, अस्, m., N. of a king.

वैणुक, अम्, n. a goad or bamboo pike (pointed
with iron and used to drive an elephant); (अस्), m.
a piper, player on a pipe or flute.

वैणुकेय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to
a bamboo, &c.

वैणिक वैणिक, अस्, m. (fr. वीणा), a lutanist,
a player on the Vīṇā or Indian lute.

वैण्य वैण्य, अस्, m. (fr. वेण), a patro-
nymic of Pṛthu son of Veṇa, (he was the fifth
sovereign of one branch of the solar race.)
